name: DESIGN-007 Frost order-flow compositions

designed.status: designed under DESIGN-007; awaiting independent design review
designed.shown: Frost POS-03 item, quantity and fire fixtures
designed.why: Keep explicit quantity commits together and keep delivery wording out of the fired tag's column. These are new compositions, not extracted provenance.

quantity-footer.layout: secondary actions on their own row; 88px stepper next to the 88px primary commit; bounds below
quantity-footer.reused: 88px Frost PIN key; 72px secondary button; 88px output; 8/12/24px Frost spacing; 150px option/secondary control width
quantity-footer.designed: An 88px primary height aligns with the quantity keys; the existing standard action remains 72px elsewhere.

round-delivery-heading.designed: A minimum-height two-column heading replaces the 32px one-line band only in the new round rendering; text wraps only within the delivery column. 48px, 12px and 8px are existing Frost dimensions, newly composed here.

draft-preview.reused: Existing totals class, 24px section separation, 12px top and 8px side padding
draft-preview.designed: Preview totals are labeled unsaved and kept inside the sheet; committed totals remain in the order panel.

status-and-recovery.reused: 14px notice text, 8px/16px spacing, existing border color and 48px compact action
status-and-recovery.designed: Polite status between list and totals; Show Steak scrolls and focuses the blocked line without changing the order.

tokens: No new palette, typography or scalar size tokens. Existing source registries and their source stylesheets remain unchanged.
